name: print-social-podcast-promo-post-set-purple-lime
title: Podcast promo set in violet with lime cutout shapes
whatItIs: A six-post Instagram preview in violet and lime, with quote headlines in bold caps, photos of hosts and microphones in dark rounded crops, and abstract lime shapes (half circles, arches) overlapping photos.
whatItMeans: Lively and professional; lime shapes turn stock photos into a branded look.
techniques: Overlay simple flat shapes on photography to brand it.
Alternate light and dark posts for rhythm within a set.
Highlight a phrase with a lime block behind text.
Show the posts inside Instagram frames with like icons.

vocabulary.definition: A flat coloured form laid over a photo.
A coloured rectangle behind key words.
An overview of several designs together.
A photo masked to a rounded-top rectangle.
